Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the joint legislative audit and review committee to review the governance structure of the department of fish and wildlife.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the governance structure of the department offish and wildlife; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The joint legislative audit and reviewcommittee shall study and review the governance structure of thedepartment of fish and wildlife. The joint legislative audit andreview committee shall review and report to the legislature on whetherproviding appointment authority of both the fish and wildlifecommission, under RCW 77.04.030, and the director of the department offish and wildlife, under RCW 77.04.055, to the commissioner of publiclands would provide for a more unified public land management approachand more effective use of public resources. This review must includeexamination and recommendations regarding the fish and wildlifecommission's role as an advisory body to the commissioner of publiclands, rather than a regulatory body as the fish and wildlifecommission currently is comprised. The joint legislative audit andreview committee shall also review and report on the issues surroundingconsolidating the department of fish and wildlife into the departmentof natural resources and solutions to make the consolidation as p. 1 SB 6043seamless and effective as possible. The joint legislative audit andreview committee shall provide a final report on this review to thelegislature by December 1, 2009.
